# OmniTune v0.9.5

Major feature update porting Velune's Queue Experience and Deep Player Menus into OmniTune.

### Features
* **Queue Multi-Select & Bulk Actions:** Fully enabled the queue's multi-select mode (long-press any track to trigger). Added fully functional bulk actions to instantly "Download" or "Add to Playlist" all selected tracks simultaneously.
* **Pitch & Tempo Controls:** Added new, precise sliders for adjusting playback Speed and Pitch directly inside the Player Options bottom sheet.
* **Media Info Dialog:** Added a new "Media Info" button to the player options that displays the current stream's Codec, Bitrate, and Sample Rate.
* **Smart Artist Selection:** If a track has multiple artists, tapping "Go to artist" now intelligently pops up a selection dialog letting you choose exactly which artist page you want to view.
* **Advanced Player Actions:** Expanded the Player Options bottom sheet into three rows, adding a direct Download button alongside the new Listen Together and Media Info options.
